Native SQL Server verification

Native execution is pending. This build environment has no SQL Server instance. The validation harness checks constraints, referential actions, transactions, OUTPUT, indexes, views, procedures and runtime error handling when you run it in a disposable SQL Server database.

Download native validation script

Create and select a disposable user database named StudyLabNativeValidation in SSMS. Review the script, run it, and keep its PASS output. It rejects other database contexts and rolls back its fixture objects. This harness covers representative behaviours; it does not certify every lesson example.
